C1854.title: Plaid Reaches $58 Million Settlement in Financial Data Aggregation Litigation
keywords: Plaid Reaches $58 Million Settlement in Financial Data Aggregation Litigation
C1854.summary: In 2021, financial technology company Plaid agreed to pay $58 million to resolve consumer data-privacy class litigation. Plaintiffs alleged that Plaid collected financial data and login credentials beyond what was necessary when connecting bank accounts to third-party apps and used interfaces resembling bank login pages. The settlement also required deletion of certain data and changes to notice, data minimization, and credential-handling practices.

references.title: Financial Technology Company Reaches $58 Million Settlement to Resolve Data Privacy Litigation
